caption: Woh pehla bite jab crispy waffle toot jaaye aur andar se almond ki richness baahar aaye... 🧇✨ Pune mein waffle ki baat ho toh The Waffy Tales ek naam hai jo genuinely alag hai. Humne try kiya Almond Affair — Crispy golden waffle, topped with almond goodness.

Jab Kolhapuri gravy naan ke saath mile... woh pehla bite aag lagata hai. Pune ke Charholi mein ek chhupa hua gem — Hotel Swaraj Family Restaurant. Smoky, deep red Kolhapuri masala with soft butter naan. 🔥🍞
Woh pehla modak ka bite — naram outer, andar meethi nariyal-gur ki filling. JyozMo ne yeh purani recipe ko zinda rakha hai. Steamed, soft, traditional Ukadiche Modak — bilkul nani-aai wala swaad. 🙏🤍

Pune mein rolls ki baat ho aur Good Food Kitchen ka naam na aaye — aisa ho hi nahi sakta. Soft rumali-style roti, juicy chicken tikka filling, tangy chutney, shredded cheese ka tarka. Smoky aftertaste = mood set. 🌯🔥

Shivajinagar mein ek shaam — Eden Court mein ghuste hi ek feel hoti hai: yaar, yeh alag hai. Smoky, perfectly charred Tandoori Chicken aur photogenic mocktails. Date night, friends gang, ya akele — sab fit baithta hai. 🍗✨
Bikaner Sweets ka Rasmalai — naram, soft gulab jamun-style balls soaked in thick saffron-flavoured milk rabdi. Charholi Budruk ka trusted local sweet shop. Ghar jaisa swaad, bina kisi drama ke. 😮‍💨🤍

Best dates aren't fancy — they are flavourful. Ragda Chaat ki tangy, spicy hit + Falooda ki sweet, creamy finish. Tanish O2 at Charholi gives serious local hangout vibes — asli swaad + sasti keemat + dil khush. 🌶️🍹
Ek aur secret spot, ek aur kahani. Discover more legendary local culinary joints on Instagram — follow the journey @yeh.safar.swaad.ka.
